parameters.query:
WITH inserted AS (
  INSERT INTO lead_events (idempotency_key, source_event_id, channel, payload, received_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5::timestamptz)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inserted) AS is_new;

WITH upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (idempotency_key, channel, name, email, phone, message, service_type, estimated_value, urgency, score, priority, sla_due_at, status, consent_to_contact)
  VALUES ($1,$2,$3,NULLIF($4,''),NULLIF($5,''),$6,$7,$8,$9,$10,$11,now()+make_interval(mins => $12),$13,$14)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE SET updated_at=now()
  RETURNING id, status
), scheduled AS (
  INSERT INTO followup_attempts (lead_id, attempt_number, provider, status, next_retry_at)
  SELECT id, 1, 'local-mock', 'pending', now() FROM upserted WHERE $15 = 'safe_followup'
  ON CONFLICT (lead_id, attempt_number) DO NOTHING
)
SELECT id, status FROM upserted;
